summary: Israeli security forces confirmed a significant threat against Yair Netanyahu, leading to his emergency evacuation. US CENTCOM reported clearing Iranian naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, enabling safe passage for oil tankers. Israeli political tensions escalated as National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir publicly clashed with Prime Minister Netanyahu over coalition negotiations.

sections.executive_summary: Israeli security forces confirmed a significant threat against Yair Netanyahu, leading to his emergency evacuation. US CENTCOM reported clearing Iranian naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, enabling safe passage for oil tankers. Israeli political tensions escalated as National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir publicly clashed with Prime Minister Netanyahu over coalition negotiations.

points: US CENTCOM announced successful removal of Iranian naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, with Navy divers, SEALs, aircraft, and support equipment clearing over 200 suspicious objects. (Source: @mamlekate/104267)
Iran's Speaker of Parliament Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf mocked US claims about oil shipments through the Hormuz Strait, calling the US Treasury Secretary a liar. (Source: @presstv/204692)
Iran's National U17 Boys Volleyball Team won their first-ever world title at the 2026 FIVB U-17 World Championship in Doha, Qatar, defeating France 3-1. (Source: @presstv/204687)
Iran's President Pezeshkian sent a message congratulating Islamic countries on the birth anniversary of the Holy Prophet Muhammad, emphasizing peace and security. (Source: @presstv/204697)
Iranian government sources reported deploying civilian forces to the Strait of Hormuz in response to what they called Trump's falsehoods. (Source: @VahidOnline/78083)
Satellite imagery showed no activity at an Iranian refinery since the 27th, according to NASA FIRMS data. (Source: @shin_persian/9189)
Israeli Security Agency confirmed a significant threat against Yair Netanyahu, leading to his emergency evacuation. (Source: @amitsegal/64330)

National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir publicly criticized Prime Minister Netanyahu over coalition negotiations involving Smotrich and Feiglin, calling it a staged reading. (Source: @amitsegal/64333)
Ben-Gvir stated he was now part of the left-wing bloc, indicating shifting political alignments. (Source: @amitsegal/64339)
Israeli police launched an investigation into a suspected murder in Jaffa, with large forces conducting searches for suspects. (Source: @N12chat/224027)
A shooting incident in Jaffa left a 20-year-old man in serious condition after being wounded on Rabbi Malkhi Street. (Source: @N12chat/224026)
A 25-year-old man was shot in Rahat and hospitalized in serious condition with penetrating injuries. (Source: @N12chat/224029)

Israeli security forces reported success in targeting several underground infrastructure sites in the Ali Tahar tunnel area as part of operations against besieged militants. (Source: @inon_yttach/9976)

The assessment within the security system indicated that while some militants managed to escape, the siege was largely maintained with many militants dying inside the tunnels. (Source: @inon_yttach/9976)
Clashes erupted in Kfar Kosa where Jewish rioters threw stones and barricaded themselves in a house, prompting security forces to evacuate them. (Source: @yediotnews25/134408)
Reports indicated Palestinian injuries at the scene of the Kfar Kosa clashes, though specific numbers were not provided. (Source: @yediotnews25/134408)
Hezbollah's military media reported detecting an Israeli reconnaissance drone approaching southern Lebanon from occupied Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/39466)
Hezbollah's military media announced artillery shelling targeting the occupied Palestinian city of Jabal al-Taher in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/39496)

Iraqi security advisor confirmed that the presence of PKK forces in Iraq is illegitimate, with cooperation underway with Turkey to resolve the issue through constitutional means. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88741)
Iraqi Kata'ib Sayyid al-Shuhada announced conditional willingness to hand over weapons to state control, demanding US withdrawal as a precondition. (Source: @presstv/204693)
US Treasury imposed strict financial restrictions on branches of Egypt's second-largest government bank operating in the UAE due to transactions with Iran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88740)

Satellite imagery confirmed the establishment of a maritime corridor behind Masirah Island, Oman, with advanced dredging operations creating a 488-meter wide and 29-meter deep channel. (Source: @mamlekate/104267)
The World Food Programme warned of a fuel bottleneck forming at three strategic points: Bab el-Mandeb, Hormuz, and the Red Sea. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94259)

sections.threat_assessment: The security situation remains highly volatile with multiple concurrent threats. Iranian-backed forces continue to pose risks in the Strait of Hormuz despite US mine-clearing operations. Hezbollah's drone detection activities indicate ongoing surveillance tensions in southern Lebanon. Domestic Israeli political instability, marked by public confrontations between government ministers, creates additional operational uncertainty. The combination of external military threats and internal political fragmentation suggests sustained high-risk conditions across the region.
sections.regional_response: US CENTCOM has taken decisive action to clear Iranian naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, coordinating Navy divers, SEALs, and aircraft in complex operations. Iraqi authorities are working with Turkey to address PKK presence while simultaneously managing domestic militia disarmament demands. Hezbollah continues monitoring Israeli aerial activities in southern Lebanon. Regional actors are balancing military preparedness with diplomatic engagement, as evidenced by ongoing coalition negotiations and international energy security initiatives.
sections.intelligence_notes: Satellite imagery confirms significant infrastructure development in the Strait of Hormuz area, including a new 488-meter wide maritime corridor behind Masirah Island. Iranian domestic activities show mixed signals with volleyball team international success juxtaposed against parliamentary criticism of US policies. Political tensions within Israel's government reveal fractures that may impact operational coordination. The World Food Programme's fuel bottleneck warning at three strategic maritime points indicates potential supply chain vulnerabilities requiring close monitoring.
